scripts.restart: npm run prepare && shardus stop && shardus clean && shardus start
scripts.dbg: shardus start 3 && shardus stop && rm -rf instances/
scripts.test:smoke: cross-env minNodes=20 nodesPerConsensusGroup=5 NODE_ENV='DEBUG' jest --detectOpenHandles --useStderr --coverage main.test.ts
scripts.test:shardedNet: cross-env minNodes=20 nodesPerConsensusGroup=5 NODE_ENV='DEBUG' jest --detectOpenHandles --useStderr --coverage shardedNetwork.test.ts
scripts.test:singleShardRotation: cross-env minNodes=10 nodesPerConsensusGroup=20 NODE_ENV='DEBUG' NodeReward=false jest --detectOpenHandles --useStderr --coverage singleShardRotation.test.ts
scripts.test:autoscaleNet: cross-env minNodes=5 nodesPerConsensusGroup=10 maxRotatedPerCycle=0 NODE_ENV='DEBUG' jest --detectOpenHandles --useStderr --coverage autoScaleNet.test.ts
scripts.release:prepatch: npm run prepare && npm version prepatch --preid=prerelease && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:preminor: npm run prepare && npm version preminor --preid=prerelease && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:premajor: npm run prepare && npm version premajor --preid=prerelease && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:prerelease: npm run prepare && npm version prerelease --preid=prerelease && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:patch: npm run prepare && npm version patch && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm run prepare && npm version minor && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm run prepare && npm version major && git push --follow-tags
